entities.name: Joseph Tyree Sneed, III
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Joseph Tyree Sneed III was an American jurist who served as United States Deputy Attorney General and then as a United States circuit judge of the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit for nearly 35 years until his death. He was the father of Carly Fiorina, a former CEO of Hewlett-Packard.
